info.name: TAVLA API
info.description:
Enterprise Restaurant Reservation Platform - REST API (v1).

**Base URL**: `{{baseUrl}}` -> `http://187.127.76.76:3000/api/v1`

**Response envelope** (all business endpoints unless noted):
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": { }, "meta": { } }
```

**Error shape**:
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "...", "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "errors": [], "timestamp": "", "path": "" }
```

**Auth**: `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. Collection-level Bearer auth reads `{{accessToken}}` automatically; public endpoints override this with `noauth`.

**Suggested first run (organization owner flow)**:
1. Authentication > Register Organization Owner
2. Verify the account (paste the emailed token into `verificationToken`) > Verify Email
3. Authentication > Login - this auto-captures `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `sessionId`, `organizationId`, `userId` into collection variables
4. Restaurants > Create Restaurant - auto-captures `restaurantId`
5. Branches > Create Branch - auto-captures `branchId`
6. Floor Plans > Create Floor Plan - auto-captures `floorPlanId`
7. Tables > Create Table - auto-captures `tableId`
8. Reservations > Create Reservation - auto-captures `reservationId`

Every other request in the collection then works without manual edits, since ids are chained automatically via test scripts (`pm.collectionVariables`).

**Idempotency**: `POST /reservations` accepts an optional `Idempotency-Key` header (client-generated UUID) - included but disabled by default; enable it and set a fixed value to test replay behavior.

**Correlation**: Mutating requests include a disabled `X-Correlation-Id` header (`{{$guid}}`) for distributed tracing - enable it if you want to correlate a request with server-side logs.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Registration, login, session/token lifecycle, and password management. Base path: `/auth`.

request.description: Issues a new access/refresh token pair and creates a device session. Rate limited to 10 requests/15min/IP. Auto-captures accessToken/refreshToken/sessionId/userId/organizationId into collection variables.
Rotates the refresh token and issues a new access token. Reusing an already-rotated refresh token revokes the entire token family. Rate limited to 30 requests/min per token.
Always returns a generic 200 acceptance response regardless of whether the email is registered, to avoid leaking account existence. Rate limited to 3 requests/hour per email.
Consumes the single-use token emailed by Forgot Password, sets a new password, and revokes all existing sessions. Paste the token from the reset email/log into `resetToken` first.

Requires the current password. Rotates the session version (revoking all other device sessions) and issues a fresh access token for the current session. Rate limited to 10 requests/15min per authenticated user.
Revokes the device session tied to the current access token only; other sessions are unaffected. Returns 204 No Content.
Revokes every device session for the authenticated user and bumps the session version, invalidating already-issued access tokens on other devices immediately. Returns 204 No Content.
Returns every non-revoked, non-expired device session, flagging which one is the current session. Auto-captures a non-current session id into `otherSessionId` for use by Revoke Session.
Revokes the targeted session by id. Only the owning user may revoke their own sessions - an unknown or foreign sessionId resolves to 404. Returns 204 No Content.
Validates username/phone availability and sends a 6-digit WhatsApp OTP via LightOTP. Does not create a User. Rate limited to 5 sends/hour/phone.
Invalidates the previous OTP and issues a new one. Subject to a 60s cooldown and the same 5/hour/phone limit as the initial send.
Marks the pending registration verified using the code received via WhatsApp (paste it into the customerOtp variable). Does not create the User yet. Max 5 incorrect attempts per issued OTP.

Requires a verified, unconsumed pending registration for this exact phone. Creates the real Customer User (username + canonical phone + password, no email) and consumes the pending registration atomically.
Authenticates a Customer by phone + password. A fully separate contract from the Owner/staff /auth/login route. Auto-captures customerAccessToken/customerRefreshToken/customerSessionId.
Enumeration-resistant: always returns the same generic response regardless of whether the phone belongs to an account. Sends a WhatsApp OTP if it does.
Same enumeration-resistant, generic response as Start. Subject to the same rate limits/cooldown.
Establishes a verified, not-yet-consumed recovery challenge. Does NOT itself change the password.
Requires a verified, unconsumed recovery challenge for this exact phone. Changes the password and revokes all existing sessions.

Authenticates a Platform Admin account (provisioned operationally, never via public API) and issues a short-lived access token signed with a dedicated issuer/audience/secret, fully isolated from the ordinary Customer/Owner/Employee JWT pipeline. Auto-captures platformAdminAccessToken.

exec: pm.test('Platform Admin login succeeded (200)', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

request.description: Creates a Restaurant Owner User and its Organization/OrganizationMember in one transaction, immediately Active with no email-verification step. Requires a Platform Admin access token (POST /platform-admin/login), never an ordinary Customer/Owner/Employee token.

item.name: Users
item.description: Self-service profile, preferences, avatar, and favorites for the authenticated user. Base path: `/users`. Every route targets the caller from the JWT - never a client-supplied user id.

request.description: Returns only the profile fields owned by the User Module (name, phone, language, preferredCurrency) - never credentials, session, or authorization internals.

Full-replace update of name/language/preferredCurrency and phone (countryCode + phoneNumber, normalized server-side to canonical E.164 - never a pre-assembled phone string, per ADR-022 Decision #13) for the caller only. Does not accept email, password, or any Authentication/Authorization field.
Returns only notificationOptIn/marketingOptIn - language/preferredCurrency remain part of the Profile contract.
Full-replace update of notificationOptIn/marketingOptIn for the caller only.
Accepts a single multipart image file (JPEG/PNG/WebP, 5MB max, validated by magic-byte signature). Replaces any existing avatar. Select a file for the `file` form field before sending.
Idempotent: favoriting an already-favorited restaurant succeeds and returns the existing favorite rather than erroring.
Idempotent: removing a favorite that does not exist is a silent no-op - always 204.
Paginated, ordered most-recently-favorited first.

item.name: Notifications
item.description: Phase 9 (frozen 2026-07-25). Base path: `/notifications`. Ownership-only authorization - no RBAC/organization scope; every route always targets the caller from the JWT, mirroring `/users/me/*`.

request.description: Paginated, ordered newest-first. Only the caller's own notifications. Set unread=true to filter to unread only. Auto-captures notificationId from the first item, if any.
A single count for a badge/indicator - the caller's own notifications only.

ADR-025. Returns a short-lived ES256 JWT proving ownership of external_id = the caller's User.id, for OneSignal.login()/updateUserJwt(). token is null when Identity Verification is not configured in this environment.
Idempotent - marking an already-read notification succeeds. A non-owned or nonexistent id returns 404 (IDOR-safe). No request body.
Marks every one of the caller's unread notifications read. No request body, no params.

item.name: Taxonomy
item.description: Public, platform-managed reference data (cuisine/occasion categories) - no authentication required.

request.description: Active cuisine categories sorted by sortOrder. Auto-captures the first category id into `cuisineCategoryId`.
Active occasion categories sorted by sortOrder. Auto-captures the first category id into `occasionCategoryId`.

item.name: Restaurants
item.description: Organization-administrative restaurant management. Base path: `/restaurants`. Requires an OrganizationMember actor with Owner or Admin role - `organizationId` always comes from the JWT.

request.description: The slug is derived from the name when omitted. Auto-captures restaurantId/restaurantSlug.
Only restaurants belonging to the caller organization are ever visible - tenant scoping is automatic.
Paginated, ordered most-recently-created first, scoped to the caller organization.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "The Old Mill",
  "description": "A cozy neighborhood restaurant serving modern Mediterranean cuisine.",
  "cuisineType": "Mediterranean",
  "priceLevel": 3,
  "status": "Active"
}

request.description: Full-replace update of name/description/cuisineType/priceLevel/status. Never accepts organizationId, slug, or averageRating.
Soft delete - sets deletedAt, never removes the row. Not idempotent: deleting an already-deleted restaurant returns 404.
Reservation settings, auto-created with defaults when the restaurant is created.
Full-replace update of every settings field, including the Phase 7.6 operational-signal fields reservationReminderMinutesBefore and lateArrivalGraceMinutes.
Restaurant-level default weekly schedule. A day absent from entries is closed that day.
Full-replace of the entire week (0=Sunday..6=Saturday) - a day omitted from entries becomes closed that day.
Accepts a single multipart image (JPEG/PNG/WebP, 5MB max), maximum 20 images per restaurant. Auto-captures galleryItemId.
Ordered by sortOrder.
Removes the gallery row, the underlying File record, and the MinIO object. Not idempotent - returns 404 if already removed.
Currently assigned cuisine categories for this restaurant.
Full-replace: the submitted ids become the restaurant's complete cuisine assignment. Run Taxonomy > List Cuisine Categories first to populate `cuisineCategoryId`.
Currently assigned occasion categories for this restaurant.
Full-replace: the submitted ids become the restaurant's complete occasion assignment. Run Taxonomy > List Occasion Categories first to populate `occasionCategoryId`.

item.name: Branches
item.description: Branch management, nested under a Restaurant. Base path: `/restaurants/:restaurantId/branches`. Same Owner/Admin authorization as Restaurants.

request.description: latitude/longitude must both be set or both omitted. Auto-captures branchId.
Only branches belonging to the caller organization are ever visible.
Paginated, ordered most-recently-created first.
Full-replace update. Never accepts restaurantId.
Soft delete - sets deletedAt. Not idempotent.
Branch-level override of the restaurant default schedule. A day absent from entries has no override configured.
Full-replace of the branch's entire weekly override - a day omitted from entries has no override for that branch.

item.name: Floor Plans
item.description: Floor plan management, nested under a Branch. Base path: `/restaurants/:restaurantId/branches/:branchId/floor-plans`. Same Owner/Admin authorization stack.

request.description: The first floor plan created for a branch becomes active automatically; subsequent ones start inactive. Auto-captures floorPlanId.
Unpaginated - a branch's floor plan count is small and bounded.
Atomically deactivates the branch's previously active floor plan - at most one active floor plan per branch at all times.
FloorPlan-scoped Table read capability - FloorPlan is the owner of the table layout.

item.name: Tables
item.description: Table management: creation/listing nested under a Branch, individual resource operations flat under `/tables/:tableId`.

request.description: Always created with status Available. tableNumber must be unique within the branch; floorPlanId must belong to this branch. Auto-captures tableId.
Paginated, ordered most-recently-created first.

Phase 6 (Merge/Split Tables, ADR-026). At least 2 distinct, currently Available tables in the same Branch and FloorPlan become one merge group sharing mergeGroupId - only the Primary (optional primaryTableId, else lowest tableNumber then id ascending) remains independently reservable; every other member becomes status Merged. Dual-actor: Owner/Admin organization member or Employee with tables:manage and branch scope (uses the collection-default {{accessToken}}). Set {{secondTableId}} to a second Table's id in the same Branch/FloorPlan before running.
Flat individual resource - tenant scoping is automatic via the Table -> Branch -> Restaurant relation chain.
Full-replace of profile fields only. Never accepts floorPlanId (see Move Table) or status (see Change Table Status).
Soft delete - sets deletedAt. Not idempotent.
Domain Action: changes ONLY floorPlanId. Target floor plan must belong to this table's own branch.
Domain Action: only Available<->Occupied, Available<->Cleaning, and Available<->Disabled transitions are allowed.

Phase 6 (Merge/Split Tables, ADR-026 decision #2): undo a merge - tableId may be ANY member of the active merge group, the full group is resolved from it. Clears mergeGroupId/isMergePrimary for every member; a former secondary becomes Available again. No Table row is created or destroyed. Same dual-actor authorization as Merge Tables (uses the collection-default {{accessToken}}). No request body.

item.name: Discovery
item.description: Customer Restaurant Discovery & Public Read Surface (2026-07-28). Base path: `/discovery/restaurants`. Every route is public/unauthenticated - no guard, no organization scope - and intentionally crosses tenant boundaries (any organization's Active, non-deleted restaurants are discoverable). This is NOT ADR-018's future Phase 15.5 search/nearby/ranking/comparison engine - plain paginated listing/detail only, reusing the exact same Response DTOs the Owner/Admin management endpoints (Restaurants/Branches/Floor Plans/Tables) already return. Run the Restaurants/Branches/Floor Plans/Tables folders first so restaurantId/branchId are populated.

request.description: Paginated, ordered most-recently-created first. Only Active, non-soft-deleted restaurants, across every organization - discovery intentionally crosses tenant boundaries. Never leaks organizationId or any other tenant-internal field.
Unknown, soft-deleted, or non-Active (e.g. Suspended) restaurants 404.
Paginated, ordered most-recently-created first.
A branch belonging to a different restaurant, or unknown/soft-deleted, 404s (IDOR-safe).

item.name: Get Active Floor Plan & Table Topology

request.description: Returns the branch's single active FloorPlan together with every non-soft-deleted Table on it (position, dimensions, shape, capacity, status, merge-group fields) - the seating-chart data a Customer reservation UX renders. 404s if the branch has no active FloorPlan configured yet. Table-level time/party-size availability is a separate call (Reservations > Search Availability, ADR-013) - never duplicated here.

item.name: Employees
item.description: Employee invitation and management, nested under a Restaurant. Base path: `/restaurants/:restaurantId/employees`. Requires Owner/Admin organization role (not RBAC permissions).

request.description: Creates an Employee with status Invited and no linked User - linking happens at first login. Set `roleId` to a Restaurant-scope Role id (see the seed data / Roles admin tooling). Auto-captures employeeId.
Domain Action: changes only roleId and bumps permissionsVersion.
Idempotent - an already-assigned branch is a no-op. The target branch must belong to the same restaurant as the employee.
Idempotent - a branch not currently assigned is a no-op. Removing the last explicit assignment restores restaurant-wide scope. Returns 200 (not 204).
Soft delete - sets deletedAt, never flips EmployeeStatus. Rejected (409) if this employee is the restaurant's last Manager-role employee. Returns 200 (not 204).

item.name: Reservations
item.description: Customer-facing reservation search and creation. Base path: `/reservations`. Guarded only by JWT (no organization/employee guard) - the actor's own userId is always used, never a client-supplied value.

request.description: Informational only - every table matching the search criteria is returned, never hidden; each carries an isAvailable indicator. This endpoint never reserves anything - POST /reservations is the sole authoritative conflict check (ADR-013).

Status is Pending unless the branch restaurant's RestaurantSettings.autoApproval is true, in which case it is created directly as Approved. reservationEndTime is derived from the restaurant's default reservation duration when omitted. source defaults to Online (self-booking, any authenticated actor); Phone/WalkIn are reachable only by an Employee actor holding reservations:create for the branch and require a reservationGuest object ({countryCode, phoneNumber, fullName, email?}) - see the 'Create Reservation (Phone/Walk-In)' example below. Enable the Idempotency-Key header to test safe retry semantics. Auto-captures reservationId.

Phase 7.4: source Phone/WalkIn requires the caller to be an Employee actor holding reservations:create for the target branch (uses the collection-default {{accessToken}}, which must belong to such an Employee/Owner) plus a reservationGuest for the walk-in/phone party (no registered User account). Rejects with 403 if the actor is a Customer, or VALIDATION_ERROR if reservationGuest is missing. Set {{secondTableId}} to a second Table's id in the same Branch before running.

Customer Restaurant Discovery & Public Read Surface (2026-07-28). Ownership-only, no RBAC - always the caller's own reservations (from the JWT), paginated, newest-created first. A guest (Phone/WalkIn) reservation has no owning User and never appears here.

Customer Restaurant Discovery & Public Read Surface (2026-07-28). Ownership-only - an unknown, another Customer's, or guest-owned reservation collapses to the same 404 (IDOR-safe, never a distinguishing 403).

Domain Action (Phase 7.2). Staff-only (reservations:approve, branch-scoped) - uses the collection-default {{accessToken}}. Only a Pending reservation may be approved; calls Table.reserve() atomically with the status transition and auto-rejects any other overlapping Pending reservation for the same table. No request body.

Domain Action (Phase 7.2). Staff-only (reservations:approve, branch-scoped) - uses the collection-default {{accessToken}}. Only a Pending reservation may be rejected. Performs NO Table operation (a Pending reservation never reserved the table). No request body. Run against a fresh Pending reservation, not the one just Approved above.

Reachable by either the reservation's own Customer (ownership-based - request auth defaults to {{customerAccessToken}}) or a branch-scoped Employee holding reservations:cancel (override the Authorization token to {{accessToken}} for an Employee actor). Never blocked by the cancellation window (unlike Reschedule) - only flags ReservationHistory.withinCancellationWindow. Pending->Cancelled performs no Table operation; Approved->Cancelled releases the Table to Available. reason is optional.

Reachable by either the reservation's own Customer (ownership-based - request auth defaults to {{customerAccessToken}}) or a branch-scoped Employee holding reservations:reschedule (override the Authorization token to {{accessToken}} for an Employee actor). All body fields are optional - any omitted field retains its current value, but at least one must be supplied. tableId (set {{secondTableId}} to a second Table's id in the same Branch to exercise a cross-table reschedule) may only target another Table within the same Branch (ADR-023's deterministic two-key advisory lock covers an Approved cross-table reschedule). Blocked with 409 RESERVATION_RESCHEDULE_WINDOW_EXPIRED once the restaurant's cancellationWindow before the current scheduled time has closed - the opposite of Cancel, which is never blocked.

Staff-only (reservations:complete, branch-scoped) - uses the collection-default {{accessToken}}, which must belong to an Employee actor holding that permission. Approved->Completed only, and only once the reservation's scheduled service window has begun (the request is rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR otherwise). Calls Table.release() unconditionally, returning the table directly to Available - never through Cleaning. No request body.

Staff-only (reservations:noshow - a dedicated permission slug, never a reuse of reservations:approve; hyphen-free because PermissionSlug rejects hyphenated segments) - uses the collection-default {{accessToken}}, which must belong to an Employee actor holding that permission. Approved->NoShow only, and only once the reservation's scheduled time has passed. Calls Table.release() unconditionally, identically to Complete (never through Cleaning). No request body.

Operational Signal (Phase 7.6) - not a status transition; status remains Approved and no Table operation is performed. Staff-only (reservations:tableready, branch-scoped) - uses the collection-default {{accessToken}}. May only be called once per reservation while it remains Approved. No request body.

item.name: Waitlist
item.description: Phase 7.5 (ADR-019, architecture frozen 2026-07-24). Base path: `/waitlist`. API surface deliberately frozen to exactly 3 endpoints - no list/reorder/dashboard/analytics endpoints exist.

request.description: Guard-light (JwtAuthGuard/SessionVersionGuard only), mirroring POST /reservations exactly. preferredDate and preferredTimeFrom are both required and together are the authoritative requested Reservation start time-of-day on promotion - not a soft preference. preferredTimeTo is optional/non-authoritative. reservationGuest (same shape as Reservations) is optional and reachable only by an Employee actor holding reservations:waitlist for the target branch - a Customer actor always joins for themselves. Auto-captures waitlistEntryId.

Reachable from Waiting or Notified, by either the entry's own Customer (ownership-based - request auth defaults to {{customerAccessToken}}) or a branch-scoped Employee holding reservations:waitlist (override the Authorization token to {{accessToken}} for an Employee actor). Mirrors POST /reservations/:id/cancel exactly. No request body.

Domain Action, staff-only (reservations:waitlist, branch-scoped) - uses the collection-default {{accessToken}}. Uses the entry's own preferredDate/preferredTimeFrom to derive the requested window and searches for an available Table server-side (never the request body). Run against a fresh, non-cancelled entry - not the one just cancelled above. On success, status becomes Converted and convertedReservationId is populated.

item.name: Health
item.description: Infrastructure health checks - unauthenticated, no response envelope, no API version segment (`/api/health`, not `/api/v1/health`).

request.description: Verifies PostgreSQL, Redis, and MinIO connectivity via Terminus.
Never checks external dependencies - only 'is the process responding'. Used by the orchestrator to decide whether to restart the container.
Same dependency checks as /health - used to pull the instance out of the load balancer without restarting it.
